name: Feeds Conditional Tamper
description: Feeds Tamper plugins that skip a whole feed item or clear a single field value when a configurable source-field condition matches.
project_description: Feeds Conditional Tamper extends the Feeds Tamper module with two Tamper plugins that conditionally drop data during a Feeds import based on a configurable condition. "Skip item on condition" (skip_item_on_condition) removes the entire feed row from the import batch when the condition is TRUE; "Skip value on condition" (skip_value_on_condition) clears only the current field value (sets it to NULL) while the rest of the row imports normally. Both plugins share one condition form implemented by ConditionalTamperBase: choose a condition source (any source field in the feed row, or the current field value being tampered), an operator (equals, does not equal, contains, does not contain, matches regular expression, does not match regular expression, is empty, is not empty), a comparison value, and a case-sensitivity flag. Regex operators use a full PHP pattern including delimiters, and the pattern is validated on save. It is a flexible alternative to the built-in "Required" plugin, which only checks empty/not-empty. Requires Drupal 10.2 or 11 plus tamper and feeds_tamper (^2.0).
